rationale: The agent correctly verified identity via email and checked both orders before acting. However, it submitted return requests without first restating the exact items/changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which the policy requires before any order-changing write. It also selected a specific refund payment method for order #W5490111 without confirming with the user; while it may match the original method, this was not verified in the visible tool output. The agent stated both returns were submitted; the tool response clearly shows “return requested” only for #W7387996, while the #W5490111 return result is unclear due to truncation, making the agent’s blanket confirmation partially unsupported. These issues violate the confirmation and accuracy requirements, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
